- Pricing for 2.0B/month commit (12-month term) with an upfront or monthly cadence

- A clear soft-throttle policy (notifications, degraded rate vs hard 429s)

I've attached May usage and the internal forecast. Can we get a ballpark by EOD tomorrow? We are trying to finalize budget ops before June 15.

Hi Samira — great to hear from you and congrats on the growth.

Short answer: yes — we can support a move to a 2.0B token/month commit on a 12-month term and we have two recommended paths depending on how you want to balance unit cost vs headroom:

Option A (cost-first): 2.0B/month committed; 12-month term; unit rate $0.0009 per token for the first 1.8B, $0.0011 per token tier above that up to 2.5B. Includes a 10% commitment discount vs current month-to-month pricing. Burst pocket: 10% included; additional burst available at 2x unit rate.

Option B (headroom-first): 2.0B/month committed; 12-month term; slightly higher commitment unit $0.0010 per token but includes 15% burst pocket and a 30% higher soft-throttle threshold (we'll set soft-throttle at the 97th percentile of your historical minute-level qps over a 30-day window).

Operational notes: provisioning the extra pool is typically a 7–10 business day lead time for Dedicated capacity; for Hosted (your current tier) we can expand capacity within 48–72 hours but may place soft-routing to add nodes for the first 10 days to smooth the transition.

I attached a draft amendment that captures Option B (recommended for seasonal retailers) — if you'd like Option A I can redline with pricing.

Want to schedule a 30-min call tomorrow at 10am PT to finalize? If yes I can loop in finance to confirm invoice cadence.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Quick ops + finance notes:

Burst pocket feasibility (Hosted):
- We can provision a 15% burst pocket for Hosted customers for a 12-month commit but it requires a temporary routing adjustment during first 14 days while autoscaler warms the extra pools. We enforce burst as a separate quota bucket; normal tokens draw from commit bucket, bursts draw from burst bucket.
- Soft-throttle approach: Recommend two stages — Notification (start at 95% of short-window sustained qps) and Gentle-degrade (rate limit per-IP/API-key to 70% of prior throughput) before hard 429s. We'll also emit webhook alerts to ShopFlux's ops webhook and create a cross-account latency trace for the first month.

Billing/story:
- Pricing suggestion aligns with Adi's Option B but propose a blended unit $0.00098/token for the 2.0B commit to be competitive and keep math tidy. Offer 30-day net invoicing monthly. If they prepay 3 months upfront we can bump discount to 12%.
- PO acceptance: standard. Finance can accept monthly invoices against a PO. For any prepay we need AR engagement (I can loop them in once they say which cadence).

Attachment suggestions to send to the customer: SOW-ShopFlux-Commit-Annex.pdf (includes provisioning schedule), and the proposed amendment docx.

I'll be on the 10am PT call.
